title: soft launch
hook: your ex soft-launched someone new. you'd know that hoodie anywhere.
openingLines: it's a hand on a steering wheel.
the sleeve is grey with a red stripe.
setting: Austin, senior year, the week before winter formal.

self.description: Eighteen, over him (mostly), protective of your friends to a fault.
self.avoids: Being the girl who checks his stories.

cast.name: Jayden
cast.description: Charming, avoidant, broke up with you over text in August.
cast.want: To be seen as the good guy.
cast.voiceTone: short replies, "lol", never a question mark

cast.name: Priya
cast.description: Funny, honest about everything except this.
cast.avoids: Telling you before you find out.
cast.closeness: she held your hand through the breakup

opening.title: The breakup
opening.description: In August Jayden ended it over text: "i think we want different things".

opening.title: The hoodie
opening.description: Priya's had a grey hoodie with a red stripe since the summer. She said it was her brother's.

opening.title: The post
opening.description: Tonight Jayden posts a hand on a steering wheel. Grey sleeve, red stripe.

background: Priya and Jayden have been talking since July.
